_meta.note: Covers all packages: filen-mobile, filen-web, filen-desktop, filen-shared, filen-office, filen-spellcheck, filen-assistant-eval. Every rule is read from the configs below or observed in the code. Edit only to fix a rule the code contradicts.

configs..prettierrc: Root config; applies to filen-mobile, filen-shared, filen-office, filen-spellcheck and filen-assistant-eval (none has its own)
configs.packages/filen-web/.prettierrc: Root options plus prettier-plugin-tailwindcss (sorts classes in className and in cn()/cva() calls; stylesheet src/index.css)
configs.packages/filen-desktop/.prettierrc: Root options minus the JSX-only ones (singleAttributePerLine, bracketSameLine, jsxSingleQuote); same output for .ts, and desktop has no .tsx

checkedByLint.filen-mobile: not checked by lint; format with the root .prettierrc
checkedByLint.filen-shared: not checked by lint; format with the root .prettierrc

prettier.eslintConfigPrettier: filen-web and filen-desktop end their ESLint config with eslint-config-prettier, so prettier alone owns formatting there

typescript.notes: Mobile: 'import { type Foo }' is the documented form (whole-statement 'import type' also appears). Every other package compiles with verbatimModuleSyntax: whole-statement 'import type { Foo }' when a module is imported for types only (an all-inline-type import would stay as a side-effect import); inline 'import { x, type T }' when mixed

notes: filen-mobile and filen-web: relative imports (./foo) are FORBIDDEN by ESLint; always use @/ aliases
filen-desktop, filen-office, filen-spellcheck and filen-assistant-eval: relative imports, no alias; filen-shared: './' siblings only
Import specifiers carry no file extension
No blank line between external and @/ imports (web lists externals first; mobile interleaves). Match the file being edited

exports.notes: filen-mobile: most files export named items + a default export at the bottom; store files export both the named store and default. Every other package exports named items only (filen-web has a single default export in src, the rest none).

jsx.notes: When a JSX element has multiple props, each prop goes on its own indented line; closing > is on its own line aligned with the opening tag

ternaries.notes: Simple one-liners stay inline; complex/nested ternaries break to multiple lines with ? and : at start of new lines

eslint.quotesRule: filen-mobile, filen-shared and filen-assistant-eval: quotes double; filen-office and filen-spellcheck: double with avoidEscape; filen-web and filen-desktop: left to prettier
eslint.presets: filen-web: typescript-eslint strictTypeChecked + stylisticTypeChecked (type-aware). Every other package: @eslint/js recommended + typescript-eslint recommended (filen-mobile also expo, react, react-hooks, @tanstack/query)
eslint.reactCompiler: enabled in filen-mobile (app.config.ts experiments.reactCompiler) and filen-web (babel-plugin-react-compiler in vite.config.ts); react-hooks compiler rules are on in both

filen-mobile.storePattern: useCameraUpload.store.ts — named export + default export, Zustand create()
filen-mobile.queryPattern: useX.query.ts — named fetchData + named useXQuery + named xQueryUpdate + default export
filen-mobile.lint: eslint --max-warnings 0 --report-unused-disable-directives; src/tests is ignored by ESLint
restrictions: Relative imports forbidden (pattern '.*'); use @/ (src/) or @/modules/* (modules/)
Import router from @/lib/router, never router/useRouter from expo-router (src/lib/router.ts is the exception)
Import pickDocuments from @/lib/documentPicker, never expo-document-picker (src/lib/documentPicker.ts is the exception)
Zustand store hooks always take a selector: useXStore(s => s.foo), never a bare useXStore()
No crypto.randomUUID (Hermes lacks it); use randomUUID from expo-crypto
No 'export * from' barrels inside src/features/
src/routes/ files (except _layout.tsx and +native-intent.ts) must not import @/features/*/store or @/features/*/queries

filen-web.relativeImports: forbidden inside src/ (vite.config.ts, scripts/ and vite/ outside src may use them)
filen-web.nonNull: no-non-null-assertion AND non-nullable-type-assertion-style are both on, so neither '!' nor a bare null-stripping 'x as T' passes. Narrow with a guard (if (x === undefined) throw/return/continue); for hot bounds-checked indexing use a local throwing at<T>(arr, i) helper, as in packages/filen-shared/src/driveSortEngine.ts
filen-web.lint: typescript-eslint strictTypeChecked + stylisticTypeChecked; prettier --check is part of pnpm run lint
restrictions: No dynamic import() in app code (only '@/e2e-hooks'); no React.lazy, lazy routes or import.meta.glob: one bundle
mediabunny only in src/workers/remux.worker.ts and src/workers/remux/** (and tests)
src/features/assistant/** and src/workers/assistant.worker.ts may not import destructive, sharing, session or raw-SDK modules (see ASSISTANT_RESTRICTED_PATHS)
filen-web.testFiles: src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx} (vitest; files needing a DOM declare // @vitest-environment jsdom)

filen-desktop.lint: typescript-eslint recommended + eslint-config-prettier; prettier --check is part of pnpm run lint
restrictions: @filen/sdk-rs: type imports only; runtime values come from the loaded addon
src/preload/** may not import node:* or ../main/* (sandboxed preload)
src/native/** may not import ../main/*; share code through src/shared

filen-shared.relativeImports: siblings only ('./'); parent-escaping '../' imports are forbidden
restrictions: Platform-free: no node:*, react, react-dom, react-native, expo, expo-* or @expo/* imports (src/tooling/** is Node-only build tooling and exempt)
Never import the package's own barrel (@filen/shared) from inside src; tests are the exception

filen-office.framework: Platform-free core (src/core) plus a React layer (src/react)
restrictions: src/core/** is platform-free: no Node, React, React Native or Expo imports and no imports of the React layer
src/core/** reaches builtins Hermes lacks (TextDecoder, structuredClone, Intl.Segmenter, toSorted, ...) only through globalThis with a fallback, inside try, or behind typeof; no RegExp v flag
Nothing may import @filen/web, @filen/mobile or @filen/desktop

filen-spellcheck.framework: TypeScript host over a Rust/wasm engine (crate/)
restrictions: src/** (except src/tests) is platform-free: no Node, React, React Native or Expo imports
Nothing may import @filen/web, @filen/mobile or @filen/desktop
filen-spellcheck.rust: cargo fmt + clippy -D warnings (pnpm run lint:rust)

notes: Tabs everywhere for TS/TSX/JS — not spaces
No semicolons, no trailing commas — both confirmed across all packages
Double quotes for all JS/TS string literals and JSX attribute values
Arrow functions omit parens for single params: 'x => x', not '(x) => x'
Classes are common for singletons (Auth, CameraUpload, Transfers) — exported as instance
Zustand stores: functional setState pattern with updater functions (fn | ((prev) => fn(prev)))

Never use non-null assertion '!'. Try to handle null/undefined cases explicitly instead of asserting non-null. If impossible, use explicit 'as Type' cast when the type is known to be non-null, rather than '!' (not in filen-web: see perPackage.filen-web.nonNull).
Use fastLocaleCompare() from @filen/shared instead of String.prototype.localeCompare() for filen-mobile and filen-web — it has better performance and consistent behavior across platforms
Use exposed run<X>() functions from @filen/shared for rust-style RAII wrappers
When functions have params, always use objects for better readability and easier future extension, except for when the function only has a single parameter
